rows.summary: Reports indicate that Donald Trump might refrain from ordering direct military actions against Iran upon taking office, provided Iranian leadership engages in credible negotiations to limit its nuclear program. This diplomatic pathway aims to ease escalating Middle Eastern tensions that have persistently threatened global crude supply chains. Lower crude costs help contain India's import bill, curb domestic inflation, and protect profit margins across oil-dependent sectors like aviation and paints.
